title: The all-day toggle creates an all-day event
preconditions: 1. You are signed in on a desktop browser with Schedule: Edit.
2. You are on the Schedule page with the event modal open.
steps: 3. Look at how it renders in day and week views.
expected: 1. With all-day on, specific start/end times are not required (the time fields are disabled or hidden).
2. The event is created as an all-day block for that technician and day.
design_ref: Claude design (authoritative, Branko Q0): build/schedule/spec-v1-2026-07-22/design-notes-claude.md (prototype Schedule.dc.html). spec_1 added the Design link to the doc.
notes: All-day rendering (where the block sits on the timeline) unpinned - capture live.
